product.one_liner: The couples budgeting app that keeps score so you don't have to.
product.positioning: Couple-specific expense splitting with a fairness dashboard.
product.north_star_metric: weekly active couples who log an expense together

personas.name: Newly cohabiting Nadia
personas.description: Just moved in with partner, splitting rent/groceries.

features.name: Fairness dashboard
features.description: Visualize running balance and contribution fairness over time.

user_stories.story: As a user I see a running fairness balance
acceptance_criteria: balance updates within 1s of adding an expense

features.platform_notes: Android: Material3 LineChart via Compose Canvas

features.name: Bank auto-import
features.description: Link a bank account to auto-import shared expenses.

user_stories.story: As a user I link my bank once

screens.name: Home / Fairness dashboard
screens.purpose: show running balance and recent shared expenses
screens.mockup_brief: Android home screen: top app bar 'Fairly', a large fairness balance card showing '+$42 you're owed', a line chart of balance over 30 days, a list of 5 recent shared expenses each with payer avatar/amount/split, a floating action button to add an expense, 4-tab bottom nav (Home, Expenses, Goals, Settings); mint green (#2BAE85) and warm white (#FAF7F2), Material 3.

monetization.paywall_placement: after 10 manual expenses or on bank-link attempt
